rule: Inspect the surrounding declaration and statement structure using the reported token and location; a parser location can be downstream of the actual defect.
limitations: Do not assume a missing terminator or insert tokens without interpreting the source.

rule: Compare state updates, reset priority, enables, widths and edge timing against the complete specification.
limitations: Aggregate mismatches do not identify a source line, signal value or root cause.

rule: Trace module definitions and conditional compilation for the selected top; determine whether an instantiated dependency is required by the specification.
limitations: A missing module does not imply that deleting its instance preserves the required behavior.
